raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE Associate Consultant (PeX) / Business Transformation Manager | Teleperformance - Bangalore Dec 2024 – June 2026 • Designed Target Operating Model (TOM) for Intuit QuickBooks delivery network - established QMS governance
standards, SOP frameworks, and continuous improvement loops across multi-vendor consulting team.
Designed As-Is and To-Be Swimlane workflow diagrams using Miro to provide end-to-end process visibility and


stakeholder alignment. Led ground truth studies across 17 Business Units to formalize quality judgment into deterministic scoring rubrics - built behavioral marker taxonomy capturing how experts evaluate subjective dimensions. Implemented calibration protocols reducing inter-annotator disagreement; established model drift detection to identify when quality frameworks degrade in production. Led onboarding and ongoing training for annotators including structured calibration sessions - provided detailed feedback on annotation quality and impact on algorithmic model performance. Coordinated knowledge-sharing to establish shared quality standards and edge-case handling before scaling production volumes.
Built working relationships with C-suite, VPs, Vendor Directors, and Site QMs - co-designed Qlik Sense dashboards for real-time performance visibility and led WBR/MBR governance cycles to drive corrective action plans for strategic performance recovery. CX Strategy and Risk Mitigation (IES Product) - Drove CX strategy for the IES product by synthesizing churn signals and Voice of the Customer (VoC) data. Identified process risks stemming from product bugs and implemented a transparency-first migration strategy to rebuild customer credibility - delivering sustained NPS improvement and reduced repeat contact rates. Key Achievements o 40% Efficiency Gain - GenAI Audit Automation: Deployed a GenAI-powered Audit Gem (LLM-powered QA)

automating CSM evaluations against a 6-point audit framework - cut audit and documentation time 40% and enabled consistent, bias-free measurement across all delivery partners.
o 2-Minute AHT Reduction: Identified that experts spent 40% of handle time on manual research across fragmented
knowledge sources. Built a dynamic knowledge assistant using Google NotebookLM - drove a 2-minute AHT reduction on live calls and improved First Time Right (FTR) scores by reducing nuanced knowledge gaps at the point of customer interaction.
Business Quality Manager | Amazon Development Centre - Bangalore • Managed delivery quality and SLA governance leading 50-member multi-region delivery team across high-severity ASIN and customer complaint workflows owning SLAs, capacity planning, resource optimisation, and escalation governance. SLA Risk Prediction and Proactive Governance - Partnered with tech teams to build SLA breach prediction logic using historical approval trends and inventory signals - enabling proactive risk interventions before service quality degradation and reducing missed delivery deadlines by 75%. Peak Planning and Change Management - Directed Prime Day and Black Friday operational planning cycles - revising SLAs, SOPs, and demand forecasts. Managing process change across 200+ employees through Agile governance and structured knowledge management. Partnered with operations, pricing, and compliance teams to identify process gaps and drive corrective action - functioning as an internal process consultant across seller and vendor workflows.
Sep 2022 - Dec 2023



Key Achievements
o SLA Reduction Initiative - $1.2M Annual Savings - Reengineered pricing delivery workflow using DMAIC - cutting SLA by 46% (3 hrs to 1 hr 37 min); eliminating 50% of uncompetitive delays; sustaining SLA adherence across multi-region operations.
o 75% Fewer Missed Delivery Deadlines: Co-built a Python ETL pipeline with intelligent routing by inventory level, price variance, and approval trends - eliminating 10,000+ redundant manual reviews daily and restoring SLA confidence across operations.
o Excel VBA Automation: Built an Excel VBA macro processing ~1M rows - auto-splitting and exporting ASIN data for Prime Day and Black Friday, eliminating a full day of 3-4 FTE manual effort per event and reducing data entry errors to zero.
Quality Manager | Unacademy - Bangalore
Sep 2020 - Jul 2022

Team Leader | First Advantage Offshore Services - Bangalore
May 2013 - Nov 2019 o 63% TAT Reduction - DMAIC Lean Transformation: Transformed Education and Employment verification
workflow using DMAIC and Lean methodologies - performed swimlane mapping, 5-Why root cause analysis, and time-motion studies addressing SOP and SLA gaps inherited during Hexaware transition. Standardized verification SOPs from scratch and collapsed TAT from 30 to 11 days (63% reduction).
o RPA and NVA Elimination - MS Visio Keystroke Mapping: Performed keystroke-level VSM/process mapping
across 21 sub-processes using MS Visio to identify automation and NVA elimination opportunities; delivered two outcomes - an OCR scanner routing data directly into systems with exception handling for manual review, and a fully unattended UiPath RPA bot eliminating a high-repetition process end-to-end, resulting in 10 FTE reduction. Managed workforce transition, stakeholder communication, and process adoption to maintain operational continuity.
Technical Support Associate | Dell International Services - Bangalore
Oct 2009 - Apr 2013
